summary: NFT Ltd, a Hong Kong-based foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the pricing and closing of a $2.01 million registered public offering of units. The offering comprised 279,600 common units and 158,357 pre-funded units, each including one Class A ordinary share (or pre-funded warrant) and one common warrant, priced at $4.60 and $4.56 per unit respectively. Net proceeds were approximately $1.76 million for working capital. Common warrants are exercisable at $4.60 per share for five years, with anti-dilution adjustments. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
